title: %inBoundingBox — test a point against a rectangle
purpose: Return true when a lat/lng point falls inside a min/max bounding box.
notes: Argument order is lat, lng, minLat, minLng, maxLat, maxLng; the result is a boolean (?).
Bounds are inclusive on every edge.

avoid.why: fractional bounds must use the number prefix (#); ##24.5 raises a parse error because an integer (##) cannot have a fractional part
